note.en: Alaska's statewide civil legal aid provider, which can help income-eligible residents with name-change filings and other civil legal needs.
note.es: Proveedor estatal de ayuda legal civil de Alaska, que puede ayudar a residentes que califican por sus ingresos con solicitudes de cambio de nombre y otras necesidades legales civiles.

note.en: Advocates for Trans Equality (A4TE) keeps a plain-language guide to changing your name and gender marker on Alaska documents. Their staff write and update it. Read it alongside this checklist.
